notes: 'The StartSelection and EndSelection keywords are optional and must both be omitted if you do not want the application to generate this information.' Half a pair means inventing the other end, which silently mislabels what the user highlighted. EndSelektion is an unknown key and is skipped, leaving StartSelection unpaired. It is the same length as the real key, so every other offset in the blob is still correct and the pairing rule is the only thing under test.
